title: Bali Event (canonical)
description: Canonical event for the lewagon-event-calendar static Bali events site. Covers a rolling 60-day window (yesterday through +60 days); dates are parsed from WITA (Asia/Makassar, UTC+8, no DST) and emitted as UTC Z times. uid is sha1(source|norm_title|start_utc).

start_utc.description: Event start in UTC (Z). Parsed from WITA (Asia/Makassar, UTC+8, no DST).

finish_utc.description: Event end in UTC (Z). Null when unknown.

cost.description: Free-text or numeric cost as scraped (e.g. 'Free entry', '150K'); null when unknown. See 'free' for the boolean filter.

source_url.description: Canonical source/detail URL the event was discovered on.

discovered_at.description: First run that observed this uid, in UTC (Z).

last_seen_at.description: Most recent run that observed this uid, in UTC (Z).

sequence.description: ICS SEQUENCE revision counter; increments on each material change.
